note: CAMPAIGN KNOWLEDGE MOVED INTO THE REPO. docs/retrospectives/README.md now carries a grouped one-line index of all 102 merged campaigns, each linking its full retrospective. Nothing to do to pick them up if core.hooksPath already points at scripts/hooks.
